lead: A `CoreCall` to a symbol with no registry row links only if `nvs_stdlib::symbols()` chains it in
body: — an arm in the module's own `address()` is not enough, and the failure is a Cranelift panic at run time reading `can't resolve symbol nvs_core_script_spawn`, naming no Novis file. `symbols()` walks `registry::CLASSES` and `CONSTRUCTORS`, so a member with a row is found for free; a rowless symbol — the prepared link entry points, `spawn script` and `await` — needs its own `.chain([...])` there beside `address`'s arm, plus a term in `every_registered_member_has_an_implementation_address`' arithmetic. Two registrations, not one, and the second has no compile-time gate at all.
